scalars.scalar_value: This is a full time, non-exempt from overtime pay (hourly paid), 1 year (benefits eligible), Term appointment with the possibility of extension or conversion to Career appointment based upon satisfactory job performance, continuing availability of funds and ongoing operational needs.

items.item_text: This position is subject to a background check. Any convictions will be evaluated to determine if they directly relate to the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Having a conviction history will not automatically disqualify an applicant from being considered for employment.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule - a combination of teleworking and performing work on site at Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, 1 Cyclotron Road, Berkeley, CA 94720. Work schedules are dependent on business needs. Individuals working a hybrid schedule must reside within 150 miles of Berkeley Lab. A REAL ID or other acceptable form of identification is required to access Berkeley Lab sites (for more information ).
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.
Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Experience with Wordpress and Figma.
Receive design assignments and deliver well-crafted visual assets, templates, and campaigns.
Design and create templates in Canva and Marq for a variety of communications materials (e.g., presentations, social media graphics, flyers, reports).
Design and produce publications, printed materials, presentations and websites for a broad range of clients.
Ensure the correct use of LBNL's styles, color palette (CMYK, RGB, and/or Hex), logos, and fonts where applicable.
Partner with stakeholders to understand project objectives, target audience, and brand voice.
Conduct thorough design research and concept development to inform content development.
Develop a library of reusable visual assets (icons, illustrations, photography treatment) for use across platforms, ensuring consistency and ease of use.
Collaborate with the Creative Services Office team to ensure all content meets quality and accessibility standards, and adheres strictly to brand guidelines.
Participate in team meetings with updates on assigned projects.
Execute and deliver visual components for communications campaigns, ensuring the output is optimized for the intended digital and print channels.
Track, organize, and maintain design assets and templates, following Berkeley Lab's and CSO's established procedures and processes.
Coordinate design and layout selections of photos, paper stocks, and other materials for execution of projects.
Prepare 4-color and spot-color electronic files for the printer using the Adobe Creative Suite and other software programs as necessary, and screen-ready files for digital applications.
Work closely with the Printing Coordinator in preparing documents for printing.
Write clear and concise printing specifications and evaluate a variety of printers' proofs.
Create scientific and editorial illustrations for academic journals and other publications.
Knowledge of digital tools and production technologies.
Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS, wireframes, and prototyping.
